subject: Request: seat-swap + onboarding credit structure for CardioAI (exec signoff needed)
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@cardioai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@cardioai.com>, partnerships@cardioai.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging ask: seat-swap + onboarding credit (need econ note)

Marcus — thanks again for the demo last week. CardioAI is excited to move forward but we ran into two practical constraints from procurement:

1) They want to convert 30 of the 300 seats in year 1 into a dedicated pilot bucket (effectively a seat-swap) to be used by clinicians for an accelerated rollout.
2) Procurement is also asking for a one-time onboarding credit to offset integration costs (~$45k).

We surface both asks because SARA (cc'd) wants to understand whether Redwood can structure this within the commercial guardrails without needing full executive approval. We prefer to avoid slowing the contract but need clarity on the approval path and any impact to ARR recognition.

I attached a summary of the MA and the proposed usage calendar. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

— Samir
CardioAI — Head of Partnerships
Attachment: CardioAI_MA_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@cardioai.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@cardioai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging ask: seat-swap + onboarding credit (need econ note)

Samir — appreciate the note and the candid ask. Short answer: possible, but it crosses two internal guardrails that typically require VP/CFO signoff: seat reallocation that materially changes usage profile, and a non-standard one-time onboarding credit above our pilot credit thresholds.

If you can confirm the expected committed ARR and timing (you included the MA but want a clean summary line), I can submit an exception memo for approval. To accelerate, we’d propose:
- 30 seats moved to a dedicated pilot pool for months 1–6, revert-after clause at month 7
- One-time onboarding credit capped at $40k (we can stretch to $45k only with exec signoff)
- 12-month minimum term remains unchanged

I’ll loop in Rev Ops for the economics write-up. Sending a quick internal note to Marissa and Ops to start the memo.

— Marcus
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CardioAI packaging ask — need exec exception (DEAL-9482)

Team — forwarding CardioAI's ask. Key points: 30-seat pilot swap (months 1–6) + onboarding credit request (~$45k). Proposed concession: seat-swap allowed; onboarding credit recommended at $40k unless Marissa/Finance approve $45k.

Why this matters: CardioAI is strategic in cardio imaging vertical; they sign annual commitment now (base ARR $720k predicted) and have strong churn signal. Allowing the pilot will accelerate adoption and upsell cadence.

Please see attached MA summary and my proposed amendment draft (two attachments). I need:
- A brief finance econ note (impact to ARR recognition and revenue hold) — Mina
- A short commercial justification memo for VP/CFO (< 1 page) — Marissa
- Any legal hooks that would prevent temporary seat reallocation — Aditya

Timing: client expects final by Wed 11/03 2pm PT. If we can get signoff by EOD Tue, I will communicate a clean concession to procurement.

Marcus
Attachment: proposed_amendment_draft.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: CardioAI packaging ask — need exec exception (DEAL-9482)

Marcus — quick econ note:
- One-time onboarding credit $40k reduces year-1 recognized ARR by ~$40k in cash-offset approach; GAAP impact is de minimis given timing, but we should treat it as a sales credit. If we approve $45k, incremental impact is the additional $5k expense and pushes our effective CAC up for this deal.
- Seat-swap: temporary reallocation for months 1–6 does not change committed seat count if the seats return at month 7; we should document the revert clause and ensure billing shows pilot-seat tagging to avoid double-billing.

Recommendation: approve up to $40k now. Anything above requires CFO signoff and a tracking credit line.

— Mina
Director, RevOps (Finance)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: CardioAI packaging ask — need exec exception (DEAL-9482)

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the econ note and the client profile. CardioAI is strategically important and the ramp benefit outweighs the marginal cost. I authorize a one-time onboarding credit of $45,000 on the following conditions:

1) The amendment must include a clear revert clause for the 30 pilot seats at month 7 and an explicit tagging mechanism in billing to prevent double-counting.
2) We require a short success milestone schedule (deliverables at month 3 and month 6) tied to the pilot seats; failure to meet milestones will trigger credit clawback language.
3) Legal to confirm the language; Aditya please draft the amendment and include the clawback and tagging language.

Marcus — you have approval to communicate the concession. Please attach the final amendment and include the milestone schedule in the SOW.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial (Redwood Inference)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@cardioai.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@cardioai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging ask: seat-swap + onboarding credit (need econ note)

Samir / Sara — good news: I have exec approval. We will approve the 30-seat pilot swap for months 1–6 and a one-time onboarding credit of $45,000. Attached is the draft amendment for your review; legal is adding the revert/clawback language and a milestone schedule (deliverables at month 3 & month 6).

Next steps:
- Sara: please confirm acceptance of the amendment by EOD Friday so we can lock in onboarding resources for a Nov 15 start.
- Samir: if you want to iterate the landmark milestones before legal finalizes language, let me know — we can do a short call tomorrow.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_amendment_draft.docx (updated pending legal)
